描述_EN: preissler was originally from bohemia (now the czech republic) but may have trained in nuremburg where this type of enamelling in black was a speciality. although the porcelain was made in china, the black enamelling and gilding was done by ignaz preissler in 1720-30. he is also known to have worked in breslau in germany and to have returned to bohemia (kronstadt) in later life to continue his work, probably with his son, daniel. the refined decoration on this chocolate beaker would have been specially commissioned by an aristocratic patron, either as a flattering gift for someone important, or as a cabinet piece which would have advertised the owner's educated tastes.
描述_ZN: Preissler最初来自波西米亚（现在的捷克共和国），但可能在纽伦堡接受过培训，在那里这种黑色的珐琅是一种专长。 虽然瓷器是在中国制造的，但黑色的珐琅和镀金是由伊尼亚兹-普雷斯勒在1720-30年完成的。 他也曾在德国的布雷斯劳工作，并在晚年回到波西米亚（喀琅施塔得）继续工作，可能与他的儿子丹尼尔一起。 这个巧克力烧杯上的精致装饰应该是由贵族赞助人特别委托制作的，要么是作为对重要人物的奉承礼物，要么是作为宣传主人有教养的品味的橱柜作品。
